question: Which of the following dam is constructed on Krishna river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagarjuna Sagar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nagarjuna Sagar Dam** is built on the **Krishna River** in the Indian states of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The construction of the dam started in 1955 and was completed in 1967.
 
• It is one of the largest and earliest multipurpose irrigation and hydroelectric projects in India.
 
• The dam has a height of 150 meters and a length of 1,450 meters, making it one of the tallest and largest dams in the world.
 
• The reservoir created by the dam, Nagarjuna Sagar Reservoir, has a storage capacity of 11.472 billion cubic meters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishna River**

 
 
• The Krishna River is one of the longest rivers in India, stretching over 1,400 kilometers.
 
• It originates in the Western Ghats near Mahabaleshwar in Maharashtra.
 
• The river flows through the states of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It ultimately empties into the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Multipurpose Projects**
 
 
• Multipurpose projects are designed to serve several purposes like irrigation, hydroelectric power generation, water supply, flood control, and recreation.
 
• Examples include the Bhakra Nangal Dam, Hirakud Dam, and Tehri Dam.
 
 
 
• **Hydroelectric Power**
 
 
• Hydroelectric power is generated by using the energy of flowing water to produce electricity.
 
• It is a renewable and clean source of energy, contributing significantly to the electricity supply in many countries.
 
 
 
• **Irrigation**
 
 
• Irrigation is the process of supplying water to crops to help them grow when rainfall is insufficient.
 
• It is essential for agriculture, especially in arid and semi-arid regions.
